cerebras_experiment_outcome_round2_2026_: RESUMED after human confirmed on the Cerebras console: balance $5.00, auto-recharge OFF, credits expire 2026-10-25 UTC, no auto-charge possible at $0 balance. Smoke test (1 call) succeeded: HTTP 200, ~670ms, ~$0.00093. The predeclared 8-case pilot (artifacts/v2/nlu_cerebras_gptoss_pilot_plan.json) then ran to completion: 8/8 schema-valid, 8/8 parse success, 0 retries needed, 0 fabricated canonical IDs, 16/16 gold entity mentions correctly typed/normalized, no B/G confusion (3/3 B-or-G cases correct), no broad false ambiguity. However, intent accuracy was 6/8 (75%): the 2 misclassifications BOTH collapsed to the same predicted class (A_literature_evidence), on exactly the two most reasoning-dependent categories (E_multi_hop_research and I_ambiguous). This is a smaller-magnitude recurrence of the exact generic-intent-collapse pattern that disqualified candidate_e_nvidia_fast (5/8) in the prior round, with an identifiable root cause (reasoning_effort='low', the lowest officially-supported setting, under-performing on the hardest reasoning categories) that has no available mechanical fix without reintroducing the latency problem this experiment targets. REJECTED at the Step 3 hard rejection gate on this basis; full dev (Step 7) correctly NOT run. The latency gate would have PASSED decisively had quality passed: true model latency (corrected for a self-throttle measurement artifact - see nlu_cerebras_gptoss_pilot_results.json's methodology_note_latency - the raw extractor wall-clock of ~12s/call was ~97% artificial 5-RPM rate-limit wait, not model latency) was P50 459ms / max 608ms pure round-trip (P50 258ms / max 341ms provider-reported inference-only time) versus the control's P50 19150ms - a ~97.6% P50 reduction. Quality has explicit priority over latency per the task's decision rule, so the candidate is rejected regardless of the latency win. Total spend this round: ~$0.0179 (smoke test + official pilot + 2 diagnostic passes to correct the latency measurement), well under the $0.50 cap. See artifacts/v2/nlu_cerebras_gptoss_pilot_results.json for full per-case detail.
